verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public first-party GitHub repository (github.com/mozilla-ai/llamafile) describing the project's code, and Mozilla files llamafile under 'open-tools', so the source appears readable. However, no item in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license; community references to code commits only suggest active public development. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. Apache/MIT), first-party statement that the source is openly licensed, independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
